resources.string: This invite came from another app. Only join if you know who sent it: while you\'re live, everyone in the crew can see where you are.
This follow-along link came from another app. You\'ll see the crew\'s photos and that they\'re safe; they\'ll see you\'re following.
This friend code came from another app. Only add them if you know who sent it: you\'ll be able to find them when they\'re live.
While you\'re live, your location is shared with your crew and friends, so they can find you.
It\'s encrypted on your phone and sent through a relay server, which can\'t read it.
Live keeps running when the app is closed, with a notification, until you turn it off.
While you\'re live, your phone also passes on other Moshpoint users\' encrypted messages over Bluetooth. It can\'t read them.
Pick the photos and videos you took that night. They\'re copied into the gig, so they stay even if you delete them from your gallery.
